test_cases.description: Verifies that AICall injects cache_control with type ephemeral on the last system message block when CacheDefault is set and system prompt exceeds the token threshold for a sonnet model.
preconditions: agentspec package is compiled; system prompt text length > 2048*4 = 8192 characters for sonnet model
test_cases.input: AICallOptions{ModelTier: TierStandard, CachePolicy: CacheDefault, System: string of length 9000}
test_cases.expected: The last system message block in the API request contains cache_control = {"type": "ephemeral"}
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: capturedRequest := captureAPIRequest(AICall, ctx, opts); lastBlock := capturedRequest.System[len-1]; assert lastBlock.CacheControl == {"type": "ephemeral"}

test_cases.description: Verifies that AICall retries without cache_control when the API rejects the request due to injected cache_control.
preconditions: Mock Anthropic client that returns cache_control rejection error on first call and success on second call
test_cases.input: AICallOptions{ModelTier: TierStandard, CachePolicy: CacheDefault, System: string of length 9000}
test_cases.expected: Returns (responseText, rawResponse, nil); second API call does not include cache_control
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mockClient.rejectCacheControlOnce(); text, raw, err := AICall(ctx, opts); assert err == nil; assert len(text) > 0; assert mockClient.callCount == 2; assert mockClient.calls[1].System[last].CacheControl == nil

test_cases.description: Verifies that AICall returns an AgentError with retryable=false after all 4 retry attempts are exhausted.
preconditions: Mock Anthropic client that always returns a 500 server error
test_cases.expected: Returns ("", nil, AgentError) where AgentError.Retryable == false and AgentError.Category is non-empty
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mockClient.alwaysFail(serverError500); text, raw, err := AICall(ctx, opts); assert text == ""; assert raw == nil; agentErr, ok := err.(AgentError); assert ok == true; assert agentErr.Retryable == false; assert agentErr.Category != ""; assert mockClient.callCount == 4

test_cases.description: Verifies that SpecSession.Generate skips generation for artifacts whose files already exist and only generates missing ones.
preconditions: SpecSession initialized; requirements.json already exists on disk; test_spec.json and tasks.json do not exist; mock GenerateArtifacts generates only missing artifacts
test_cases.expected: Returns (GenerateResult including all 3 artifacts, nil); GenerateArtifacts is called only for test_spec and tasks
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: writeFile(tmpDir + "/requirements.json", existingRequirementsJSON); session := newTestSpecSession(tmpDir); mockAgent.captureGeneratedArtifacts(); result, err := session.Generate(ctx); assert err == nil; assert len(result.ArtifactList) == 3; assert mockAgent.generatedArtifacts does not contain "requirements"; assert mockAgent.generatedArtifacts contains "test_spec"; assert mockAgent.generatedArtifacts contains "tasks"

test_cases.description: Verifies that SpecSession.Generate does not transition to StateGenerated and persists the error as lastError when GenerateArtifacts fails.
preconditions: SpecSession initialized; mock GenerateArtifacts returns an error
test_cases.expected: Returns (GenerateResult{}, error); session state is not StateGenerated; lastError is set in persisted state
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: session := newTestSpecSession(tmpDir); mockAgent.returnError(agentErr); result, err := session.Generate(ctx); assert result == GenerateResult{}; assert err != nil; persistedState := loadStateFromDisk(tmpDir); assert persistedState.State != StateGenerated; assert persistedState.LastError != nil

property_tests.description: For any valid tier constant or ModelRegistry key, ResolveModel returns a non-empty model ID and nil error.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample from the union of all tier constant strings (case-insensitive variants: SIMPLE, simple, Simple, STANDARD, standard, ADVANCED, advanced) and all keys in ModelRegistry (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6)
property_tests.invariant_check: modelID, err := ResolveModel(name); assert err == nil; assert len(modelID) > 0

property_tests.description: For any string that is neither a tier constant nor a ModelRegistry key, ResolveModel returns an empty string and a non-nil error.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random strings of length 1-50 using characters [a-z0-9-] that do not match any tier constant or ModelRegistry key; also include empty string and strings with special characters
property_tests.invariant_check: modelID, err := ResolveModel(name); assert modelID == ""; assert err != nil

property_tests.description: AICall makes at most 4 total attempts before returning an error, regardless of the number of consecutive transient failures.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each error type in [rateLimitError, serverError500, serverError503, connectionError], configure a mock client that always returns that error; run AICall and count total attempts
property_tests.invariant_check: mockClient.callCount <= 4; if mockClient.alwaysFails then err != nil

property_tests.description: cache_control is injected if and only if CachePolicy is not CacheNone and the estimated token count exceeds the model-specific threshold.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample combinations of: systemPromptLength in [0, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 32768], CachePolicy in [CacheNone, CacheDefault, CacheExtended], modelTier in [TierSimple, TierStandard, TierAdvanced]
property_tests.invariant_check: estimatedTokens := len(systemPrompt) / 4; threshold := modelThreshold(modelTier); shouldInject := cachePolicy != CacheNone && estimatedTokens > threshold; capturedRequest := captureAPIRequest(AICall, ctx, opts); hasCacheControl := capturedRequest.System[last].CacheControl != nil; assert hasCacheControl == shouldInject

property_tests.description: LoadPrompt returns a non-nil error and reads no file from disk for any name containing characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9_-].
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate strings containing at least one character from the set [./ \\!@#$%^&*()+=<>?] prepended or appended to a valid name; also include pure special-character strings and path traversal patterns like "../etc/passwd"
property_tests.invariant_check: content, err := LoadPrompt(invalidName, tmpDir); assert err != nil; assert content == ""; assert mockFS.readCount == 0

property_tests.description: LoadPromptTemplate safe substitution preserves unmatched $variable references verbatim and replaces all matched references.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate template strings with 0-5 $variable references; generate vars maps that match 0 to all of those variables; sample variable names from [a-z_]{3,15}
property_tests.invariant_check: result := safeSubstitute(template, vars); for each $var in template: if var in vars then assert !strings.Contains(result, "$"+var) && strings.Contains(result, vars[var]); else assert strings.Contains(result, "$"+var)

property_tests.description: GenerateArtifacts makes at most 2 repair attempts per artifact before returning an error when validation always fails.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Configure mock AICall to always return an invalid payload for a given artifact; run GenerateArtifacts and count calls per artifact
property_tests.invariant_check: mockAICall.requirementsCallCount <= 3; err != nil after exhaustion (1 initial + 2 repair = 3 max calls per artifact)

property_tests.description: SpecSession methods Assess, Refine, and Generate never call os.Exit under any error condition.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each method, inject errors at each possible failure point: AssessPRD error, RefinePRD error, GenerateArtifacts error, file write error, state persist error, context cancellation
property_tests.invariant_check: wrap each method call in a goroutine with os.Exit monitoring; assert process does not exit; assert method returns an error value

property_tests.description: SpecSession.Refine never records a QA exchange or modifies the PRD file on disk when RefinePRD or the PRD file write fails.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Inject errors at two points: (1) RefinePRD returns error, (2) PRD file write fails after RefinePRD succeeds; run Refine for each scenario
property_tests.invariant_check: prdBefore := readFile(prdPath); session.Refine(ctx, answers); prdAfter := readFile(prdPath); assert prdBefore == prdAfter; persistedState := loadStateFromDisk(tmpDir); assert len(persistedState.QAExchanges) == 0

property_tests.description: SpecSession.Generate only calls GenerateArtifacts for artifacts whose files do not already exist on disk.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample all 8 subsets of {requirements.json, test_spec.json, tasks.json} as pre-existing files; for each subset, run Generate and capture which artifacts are passed to GenerateArtifacts
property_tests.invariant_check: for each artifact in [requirements, test_spec, tasks]: if artifactFile exists on disk before Generate is called, then artifact must not appear in the set passed to GenerateArtifacts

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test covering the full spec authoring lifecycle: assess, refine, and generate all three artifacts through the SpecSession state machine.
smoke_tests.trigger: Create a SpecSession with a sample PRD file; call Assess(ctx), then Refine(ctx, answers), then Generate(ctx) in sequence
mockable: filesystem (state persistence, PRD file, artifact files)
expected_effects: Assess returns a non-zero Assessment with nil error
Session state file on disk contains assessment history entry after Assess
Refine returns a new Assessment with nil error; PRD file on disk is updated; QA exchange is recorded in session state
